named_mutations.label: Create Work
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Creation requires an explicit new resource ID or all permitted resources; a hierarchy alone cannot authorize unattached creation.

named_mutations.label: Edit Work
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Change permitted fields of matching Work items.

named_mutations.label: Set progress
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Completion may also require a separately authorized ReviewPacket and evidence links.

named_mutations.label: Add dependency
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Both ends of the relationship must be authorized for this action.

named_mutations.label: Remove dependency
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Both ends of the relationship must be authorized for this action.

named_mutations.label: Add blocker
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Both Task endpoints must be authorized for this action.

named_mutations.label: Remove blocker
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Both Task endpoints must be authorized for this action.

named_mutations.label: Move Work
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Current and destination containers must be authorized; the receiver checks before and after the move.

named_mutations.label: Assign workflow
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Assign a workflow to matching Work items.

named_mutations.label: Transition workflow
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Workflow gates still apply to matching Work items.

named_mutations.label: Archive Work
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Archive matching Work items.

named_mutations.label: Restore Work
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Restore matching archived Work items.

named_mutations.label: Accept proposal
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Authorize the Proposal and the new Decision separately, using exact IDs or all permitted resources.

named_mutations.label: Convert proposal
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Authorize the Proposal, Issue and new Decision. Proposal and Decision records cannot inherit a Work hierarchy wildcard.

named_mutations.label: Reject proposal
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Authorize the Proposal and new Decision separately.

named_mutations.label: Review workflow
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Authorize the Work item and each ReviewPacket, Handoff or evidence link touched by the review.

named_mutations.label: Create Arena
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Authorize the new Arena ID or all permitted Arena resources. This does not grant credential administration.

named_mutations.label: Edit Arena
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Change the selected Arena records; no sibling Work access is implied.

named_mutations.label: Archive Arena
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Archive the selected Arena records subject to the receiver's lifecycle checks.

named_mutations.label: Move Work between Arenas
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Authorize the Work item and both prior and destination Arena records. Scope is checked before and after the move.

named_mutations.label: Attach session provenance
named_mutations.resource_requirements: Exact Work subject and every derived SessionRef and SessionLink ID must be admitted together; native source IDs supply no authority.

resource_requirements: One existing exact SessionRef; independent state revision. No linked Work or child session mutation.
